mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, module_name, action, description, detail, method, uri, ip, success, error_msg) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{moduleName}, #{action}, #{description}, #{detail}, #{method}, #{uri}, #{ip}, #{success}, #{errorMsg})

where.if: AND (description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, user_id, username, module_name, action, description, detail, method, uri, ip, success, error_msg, create_time FROM audit_log
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
